support_policy.standard: All projects include a standard post-delivery support period ranging from 7 to 90 days depending on the contract package.
support_policy.maintenance_plans: We offer monthly maintenance plans starting at $150/month which cover minor updates, security monitoring, and regular updates.

revision_policy.details: We offer unlimited revisions during the visual design phase (Figma wireframing). After coding starts, revisions must remain within the agreed project scope. Significant scope expansions will be quoted separately.

refund_policy.details: Refunds are processed depending on project stages. Up to 100% refund is possible if the research phase hasn't started. After mockup approvals, refunds are prorated to cover designer hours spent. No refunds are available once coding is finalized.

data_privacy.details: Client code bases, database credentials, and business statistics are handled with strict privacy protocols and are never shared with third parties.
